name: Web3 Security Checklist API
shortDescription: Defensive smart-contract audit-readiness rubric with score, grade and red flags
description: Deterministic, defensive smart-contract audit-readiness checklist. Declare which security practices a contract follows (independent audit, verified source, access control, reentrancy protection, timelock, multisig admin, test coverage, pause mechanism, bug bounty, known-vuln status); returns a 0–100 readiness score, an A–F grade, per-item pass/fail, missing critical items, and red-flag warnings (e.g. owner can drain funds, upgradeable without timelock) that force a do-not-deploy. A self-assessment rubric — NOT an audit. No bytecode analysis, no LLM. /assess scores, /lookup adds reasoning and remediation.
